title: Correct free-fall time
description: Essential: The solution must correctly state or use the time for vertical free fall over height h: t = sqrt(2h/g).

title: Correct circular motion time
description: Important: The solution must relate the horizontal motion to n complete circles, giving a time of t = n * 2πR / v0.

title: Final velocity v0
description: Essential: The final expression for the entrance velocity must be derived by equating the two times, yielding v0 = n * 2πR * sqrt(g/(2h)) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Centripetal force expression
description: Important: The solution must identify that the normal force provides the centripetal force: N = m*v0^2 / R.

title: Final normal force N
description: Essential: The final expression for the wall pressure must be derived by substituting the correct v0 into the centripetal force formula.

title: Misinterpreting n
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution treats n as a variable other than the number of complete horizontal circles made during the fall.

title: Ignoring vertical independence
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assumes the vertical motion affects the horizontal speed or centripetal force requirement.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution may demonstrate that the final expressions for v0 and N have correct physical dimensions (LT^-1 and MLT^-2 respectively).
